# ChatGPT Conversation Recovery Dynamics

> A reproducible client-side study of conversation recovery failures, HTTP 429 dynamics, history-aware recovery state, provider-friendly recovery design, and the fork-friendly Purrtocol universe.

Important interpretation rules:
- Observed, recomputed, modeled, simulated, proposed, weak external, and unknown claims are deliberately separated.
- This project does not claim OpenAI's internal root cause, production topology, exact rate-limit scope, capacity, or queue sizes.
- Raw authenticated HAR files are not published.
- Purrtocol is an anthropomorphic error model and communication layer, not evidence.
- Current 3D frontier: PKE-106 is PREPRODUCTION; no runtime 3D model has been promoted.
- Forked Purrtocol variants are welcome. Lineage is provenance, not approval or ranking.
- The Sam/Tibo observation horizon is a story mechanic only; named-person attention is NOT OBSERVED and is not monitored.

Core observed/recomputed anchors:
- 108 paired observations: 48 Accessible, 60 Blocked, 0 mixed.
- Cycle law: Delta ~= 5.6164 + 0.9566 * service_time, R^2 ~= 0.99136.
- In this capture, all 8 first Accessible reentry observations after Blocked returned to Blocked next.
- H/E/B history-aware state modeling outperforms first-order A/B within the capture.

Safety:
Do not load-test production OpenAI services, create synthetic retry storms, deliberately trigger 429s, or bypass rate limits. Prefer passive observation and local simulation.

## Core research

- [Clean project entry](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/index.md): Compact Markdown map of the project.
- [Evidence ledger](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/evidence-ledger.md): Claim classes and explicit unknowns.
- [Recovery design](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/recovery-design.md): Start anchoring, single-flight, observation before materialization, and recovery hysteresis.
- [Deep validation](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/deep-validation.md): Sensitivity, residual memory, change points, and cross-epoch checks.
- [Provider-friendly congestion control](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/server-friendly-congestion-control.md): Retry amplification and graceful degradation.
- [Methodology](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/docs/methodology.md): Pairing, timing, sessionization, and limitations.

## Reproduction and public data

- [Public analysis script](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/scripts/analyze_public_data.py): Recompute the sanitized trace analysis.
- [Sanitized event stream](https://github.com/hopeless-t/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/blob/main/data/session_b_events.jsonl): Public derivative telemetry.
- [Recovery Helper](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/recovery-helper/): Local-only bilingual troubleshooting surface.

## Learning surfaces

- [Purrtocol University](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-university/): HTTP, distributed systems, queueing, statistics, control, and epistemology.
- [Evidence Court](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/evidence-court/): Claim classification game.
- [Queueing Restaurant](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/queueing-restaurant/): Explicitly toy M/M/1 queueing surface.
- [Incident Investigation Board](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/incident-board/): Facts, hypotheses, unknowns, actions.
- [Agent Retry Academy](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/agent-retry-academy/): Operation identity, attempt identity, and re-observation.
- [Purrtocol Museum](https://hopeless-t.github.io/chatgpt-recovery-dynamics/purrtocol-museum/): Repository archaeology.
